name: Sports Partnership Proposal
tagline: Complete 32-page Sports Partnership Proposal display system with its own typography, composition and layout vocabulary.

palette.description: Source-specific colors retained in native text, shapes, tables and image treatments; not normalized across templates.

typography.style: DM Sans replaces source General Sans with user approval. Headings use the actual DM Sans italic variable font at weight 700, preserving the original size, uppercase treatment, tight line height and frames; body uses DM Sans and small labels retain Geist Mono. Original unmodified OFL font files and license notices are embedded. This is a similar-font adaptation, not the original General Sans.

best_for: Sports partnership proposals, sponsorship opportunities, audience and reach stories, team credentials, commercial collaborations and clear next-step plans.
avoid_for: Dense technical specifications, subdued editorial narratives, or stories requiring large tables rather than bold headings and sports photography.
